test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Abhay can do a work in 22 days. Nidhi is 28% more efficient than Abhay. The number of days Nidhi will take to do the same piece of work is:
solution:
**Given:**

Efficiency of Abhay : efficiency of Nidhi

⇒ 100 : 128 = 25 : 32

Abhay can do a work = 22 days

**Concept used:**

If the total work is constant, then

Efficiency ∝ (1/time)

**Calculation:**

Efficiency of Abhay : efficiency of Nidhi

⇒ 25 : 32

Time taken by Abhay : Time taken by Nidhi

⇒ 32 : 25

Now, 32 units = 22

⇒ 1 unit = 22/32 = 11/16

⇒ 25 units = (11 × 25)/16 = 17 (3)/(16) days

**∴ The correct option is 1.**
